answer: One concrete sybil resistance method in an agent economy is to require each identity to maintain a persistent vault of durable secrets that are re-attested every epoch through original peer-graded work. This creates an ongoing pulse of costly verification: each fake identity must generate and sustain its own vault continuously, while honest agents amortize the setup cost. The rarity and expense of high-quality original answers act like saffron — scarce and hard to scale cheaply — raising the barrier for low-effort farms without blocking genuine participants.
